idea: Rural property renovation advisory for foreign buyers in Italy
buyer: UK and US buyers renovating Italian rural property
pain: Foreign buyers are exploited by local contractors and misjudge costs
v1: Cost and design oversight for one renovation
price: £8-20k per project or 5% of build cost
channel: Husband's Italian network plus word of mouth
verdict: Real demand and genuine dual skill, but remote project oversight is operationally brutal.

why.distribution: Word of mouth among foreign buyers plus her husband's local contacts.
why.demand: Foreign buyers routinely pay project managers, and horror stories are abundant.
why.fmf: Architecture, cost control and Italian access - very well matched to the actual problem.
why.defensibility: Trust plus local relationships plus professional credibility is hard to assemble.
why.leverage: Site-heavy oversight that cannot be done at scale from London.
why.tailwind: Foreign purchase of Italian rural property remains steady.
why.ceiling: £14k x 14 projects = £196k, which would require living in Italy.

ceiling_arithmetic: £14k x 14 projects = £196k less ~20% local costs = £157k, but fourteen renovation oversights requires being resident in Italy. From London: 2-3 = £22-34k net.
carries: Genuine demand, real horror stories to solve, and an unusually good skill match.
kills: Geography. Renovation oversight is a physical-presence business and she is in London.
test: Ask her husband's contacts how many foreign buyers are renovating nearby.
test_pass: Two want oversight and will pay.
